source.title: Lorsan - Windweaver Protector
source.name: Lorsan
source.description: A free-spirited Support who transfers damage between enemies by linking them with wind magic.

skills.name: Whispering Tempest

description.raw: Lorsan channels his power to summon a storm centered on the frontmost enemy, lasting for 5s. Enemies within 2 tiles of the target are affected by the storm, suffering a 30 + 3 (SP-based) Haste reduction and taking from 50% (ATK-based) + 6% (SP-based) damage from Lorsan every 0.5s.
active: Lorsan channels his power to summon a storm centered on the frontmost enemy, lasting for 5s.

skills.description_lite: Lorsan summons a storm, dealing continuous damage to enemies within its range and reducing their Haste.

skills.name: Stormbound Retribution

description.raw: When a battle starts, Lorsan links the nearest and farthest enemy heroes to each other with Stormbound Chain. The chain transfers 70% + 10% (SP-based) of the damage taken by one of the linked enemies to the other. Damage transferred by the chain cannot exceed 500% of Lorsan's ATK and will not defeat the enemy. The chain breaks when its total damage dealt to both enemies reaches 900% of Lorsan's initial ATK, or if one of the linked enemies is defeated.

skills.name: Zephyr's Embrace

description.raw: Lorsan protects the weakest ally with Zephyr's Embrace for 6s. While active, the protected ally gains 50 Dodge, 30 + 3 (SP-based) Haste, and recovers 90% (ATK-based) + 12% (SP-based) HP per second.

description.raw: Lorsan recovers 200% (ATK-based) of HP for all allies when Stormbound Chain breaks. He will then cast Stormbound Chain again, with a maximum of 3 casts per battle.
